description:
You are an online merchant looking to increase your store's average order value by configuring product recommendations. Navigate to the WooCommerce Products list and edit the product 'USB-C Laptop Charger 65W'. In the Product data section, click on the 'Linked Products' tab and configure the following:

**Upsells** (shown on the product page as upgrade suggestions):
- Wireless Bluetooth Headphones

**Cross-sells** (shown in the cart as complementary items):
- Organic Cotton T-Shirt
- Slim Fit Denim Jeans

After adding all linked products, click 'Update' to save the changes.

The browser is already open to the WooCommerce Products list page.
